lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Emotional Dependency, Exodus booklet (1987)
lines.text: sold in five-packs by an Exodus network, June 2016

lines.head: TAUGHT IN — Focus on the Family booklet (2001), pp. 10, 14
lines.source: Focus on the Family, The Heart of the Matter: The Roots and Causes of Female Homosexuality (© 2001), printed p. 10 (PDF p. 8): "Lesbianism results from three primary conditions: Relationship issues, An identity struggle, A spiritual fallacy"; printed p. 14 (PDF p. 10): "The lesbian struggle is not a sexual orientation problem; it is an identity crisis." Smithsonian NMAH.AC.1428 B6 F4

lines.head: KNOWN — the WHO's office for the Americas, May 2012
lines.text: homosexuality is not an illness and “requires no cure”
lines.source: Pan American Health Organization (Regional Office of the WHO for the Americas), "'Cures' for an illness that does not exist" (position statement, May 2012), p. 1: "…does homosexuality constitute a disorder or an illness, and therefore it requires no cure"; news release 17 May 2012, paho.org/en/news/17-5-2012-therapies-change-sexual-orientation-lack-medical-justification-and-threaten-health, read 15 Nov 2026

lines.head: KNOWN — Exodus International closed, 19 June 2013
lines.text: announced at its own conference; its president apologised
lines.source: Religion News Service in The Christian Century (24 July 2013 issue), "'Ex-gay' group closes as its president apologizes": closure announced June 19 at the ministry's 38th annual conference; christiancentury.org/article/2013-06/ex-gay-group-exodus-international-shuts-down-president-apologizes, read 15 Nov 2026

lines.head: KNOWN — Royal College of Psychiatrists, 2014, p. 2
lines.text: “no sound scientific evidence” that orientation can change
lines.source: Royal College of Psychiatrists, Position Statement PS02/2014 (April 2014), p. 2: "There is no sound scientific evidence that sexual orientation can be changed." rcpsych.ac.uk (ps02_2014.pdf), read 15 Nov 2026
